items.reason: src/sentry/spans/consumers/process/factory.py:134-141 copies end_timestamp_precise from the incoming payload without validation, and src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:197-199 uses it directly as the score. The newly added ZPOPMIN at src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua:62-63 therefore preferentially retains future-dated injected spans and evicts legitimate lower-scored spans when the same segment exceeds 1,000 members.

src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:192-199 groups spans and inserts each subsegment together before executing the per-span scripts. Both unions are conditional on nonempty source sets and immediately unlink those sources (src/sentry/scripts/spans/add-buffer.lua:46-54), so subsequent spans already joined do not repeatedly copy the set as claimed; the base also used full-set unions under the same conditions.
